type immigrant_status = {
  accorded_permanent_residence : bool; (* 7701(b)(6)(A): lawfully accorded privilege of residing permanently as immigrant *)
  status_revoked : bool; (* status has been revoked *)
  status_abandoned : bool; (* status administratively or judicially determined abandoned *)
}

type treaty_cessation = {
  treated_as_treaty_resident : bool; (* commences to be treated as resident of foreign country under tax treaty *)
  waived_treaty_benefits : bool; (* individual waives benefits of treaty applicable to residents of foreign country *)
  notified_secretary : bool; (* individual notifies Secretary of commencement of such treatment *)
}

(* 7701(b)(6)(A) and (B): status accorded and not revoked/abandoned *)
let has_lawful_permanent_resident_status (status : immigrant_status) : bool =
  status.accorded_permanent_residence &&
  not status.status_revoked &&
  not status.status_abandoned

(* flush clause: ceases to be treated as lawful permanent resident under treaty tie-breaker *)
let ceases_under_treaty (cessation : treaty_cessation) : bool =
  cessation.treated_as_treaty_resident &&
  not cessation.waived_treaty_benefits &&
  cessation.notified_secretary

(* 7701(b)(6): is individual a lawful permanent resident at given time *)
let is_lawful_permanent_resident (status : immigrant_status) (cessation : treaty_cessation) : bool =
  has_lawful_permanent_resident_status status &&
  not (ceases_under_treaty cessation)

ocaml:
type exempt_clause =
  | ClauseII  (* treated as exempt individual under (A)(ii) - teacher or trainee *)
  | ClauseIII (* treated as exempt individual under (A)(iii) - student *)

type individual = {
  exempt_years : (int * exempt_clause) list; (* calendar years, and clause, individual was an exempt individual *)
  compensation_under_872b3 : bool; (* all of individual's compensation is described in section 872(b)(3) *)
  establishes_no_permanent_residence_intent : bool; (* individual establishes to Secretary's satisfaction no intent to permanently reside in US *)
  meets_subparagraph_d_ii : bool; (* individual meets requirements of subparagraph (D)(ii) *)
}

(* (E)(i): teacher/trainee exempt status barred if exempt under (A)(ii) or (iii) in 2 (or 4, if all compensation under section 872(b)(3)) of preceding 6 calendar years *)
let is_limited_teacher_trainee (current_year : int) (individual : individual) : bool =
  let threshold = if individual.compensation_under_872b3 then 4 else 2 in
  let preceding_exempt_count =
    List.length
      (List.filter
         (fun (year, _clause) -> year < current_year && year >= current_year - 6)
         individual.exempt_years)
  in
  preceding_exempt_count >= threshold

(* (E)(ii): student exempt status barred after 5th calendar year of exemption under (A)(ii) or (iii), unless intent + (D)(ii) shown *)
let is_limited_student (current_year : int) (individual : individual) : bool =
  let exempt_years_sorted = List.sort compare (List.map fst individual.exempt_years) in
  match List.nth_opt exempt_years_sorted 4 with
  | None -> false (* fewer than 5 exempt years so far, limitation not yet triggered *)
  | Some fifth_exempt_year ->
    current_year > fifth_exempt_year
    && not (individual.establishes_no_permanent_residence_intent
            && individual.meets_subparagraph_d_ii)

(* groups the two independent teacher/trainee and student limitation rules of (b)(5)(E) *)
module SpecialRulesTeachersTraineesStudents = struct
  let is_limited_teacher_trainee = is_limited_teacher_trainee
  let is_limited_student = is_limited_student
end
